425:t_1:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「If he's not here, he's probably off running simulations.」

425:t_1:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Maybe he's doing his Jeet Kune Do training.」

425:t_1:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Even though $$ジェニオン$$ got a power-up, he's really so serious.」

425:t_1:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「Daily training is what produces results in battle. A soldier who neglects routine training will never win.」

425:t_1:9.en:
$$カイエン$$
「$$宗介$$ is right. $$アマタ$$, you should follow $n's example a little.」

425:t_1:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I do think I'm doing a decent amount, though...」

425:t_1:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But the source of $$アクエリオン$$'s power is $$アマタ$$'s power of love, isn't it?」

425:t_1:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So getting all lovey-dovey LOVE with $$ミコノ$$ is the training!」

425:t_1:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'd really like to hear the details.」

425:t_1:19.en:
$$アマタ$$
(Ahh, that bashfulness is just irresistible~!)

425:t_1:20.en:
$$アルト$$
「You guys are really easy to read.」

425:t_1:21.en:
$$シュレード$$
「But it's a fact that $n's training sometimes reaches a level beyond reason.」

425:t_1:22.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Agreed. I've trained with him before, and that... is a little abnormal.」

425:t_1:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But it's also a fact that it's what keeps bringing him victories...」

425:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ジェニオン$$'s $$スフィア$$, the $$いがみ合う双子$$, activates its power with opposing emotions as the key...」

425:t_1:27.en:
$$シン$$
「And those would be the hope and despair inside $n, huh.」

425:t_1:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You can't call it smooth sailing, but $n has overcome hardship after hardship and won victory after victory until now...」

425:t_1:29.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I think the key was his heart that never gives up... his heart that believes in hope.」

425:t_1:30.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I think so too. $n has always fought believing in hope...」

425:t_1:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「$n is activating the $$スフィア$$... If that's the case...」

425:t_1:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「You mean there is always as much despair inside him as there is hope?」

425:t_1:35.en:
$$シン$$
「Wait...! Then the despair inside him has to be enormous!」

425:t_1:36.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Do you mean the father and sister he lost in the $$時空震動$$...?」

425:t_1:37.en:
$$カレン$$
「And the existence of the $$テンシ$$ said to have caused it...」

425:t_1:40.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's true that the incident and the existence of $$テンシ$$ were a wound and a terror to $n.」

425:t_1:41.en:
$$アルト$$
「But by fighting in the $$ジェニオン$$, he has been overcoming them.」

425:t_1:42.en:
$$宗介$$
「I agree. To $n, those are reasons to fight, and they're probably separate from despair.」

425:t_1:43.en:
$$甲児$$
「Right... He's the kind of guy who, when there's hardship, fights to overcome it.」

425:t_1:44.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then is the despair $n is carrying something that can't be overcome no matter what?」

425:t_1:45.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's what it comes down to...」

425:t_1:46.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Despair that can't be overcome...」

425:t_1:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「...There's no use in us thinking about it.」

425:t_1:50.en:
$$アルト$$
「But this is $n's problem. And it has probably taken root somewhere so deep he can't even talk to us about it.」

425:t_1:51.en:
$$シン$$
「You mean he's the only one who can resolve it...」

425:t_1:52.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What we have to do now is conquer the southern Central Continent as quickly as possible.」

425:t_1:53.en:
$$カイエン$$
「If we hit the $$サイデリアル$$ in this area, $$翠の地球$$ is as good as liberated, then.」

425:t_1:54.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Which is why the $$サイデリアル$$ will gather their remaining forces from all over.」

425:t_1:55.en:
$$甲児$$
「What about movement from $$蒼の地球$$?」

425:t_1:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ has gone up to space and is keeping watch there, so if there is any large-scale movement, we'll be notified right away.」

425:t_1:57.en:
$n
「What, everyone's here... You were in the salon.」

425:t_1:59.en:
$n
「What is it, $$カレン$$? Looking at me with teary eyes...」

425:t_1:60.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't tell me you have a thing for $n too!?」

425:t_1:61.en:
$$カレン$$
「No way! Not for a clueless dolt who can't read the room like this...!」

425:t_1:62.en:
$n
「...It beats being called the quiet type, but hearing it said so bluntly still gets me down...」

425:t_1:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do you need something from us, $n?」

425:t_1:65.en:
$n
「I've finished my daily training. So I was thinking of getting someone to spar with me in a mock battle.」

425:t_1:66.en:
$$アルト$$
「I knew it. That's what this is about.」

425:t_1:67.en:
$n
「Tomorrow we launch a surprise attack on the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ that controls this whole area. Think of it as a warm-up.」

425:t_1:72.en:
$n
「That line doesn't suit you at all.」

425:t_1:73.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're the last person who should say that.」

425:t_1:74.en:
$n
「I'll hand it right back to you.」

425:t_1:75.en:
$$カレン$$
「Bickering won't make you stronger, $n. If you want a sparring partner, I'll do it.」

425:t_1:76.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You do have a thing for him after all, don't you?」

425:t_1:78.en:
$n
「Then I can pound you without holding back.」

425:t_1:79.en:
$$カレン$$
「Big talk from a guy with an all-time head-to-head record of 12 wins and 46 losses.」

425:t_1:80.en:
$n
「I'll get my win count up to 20 today.」

425:t_1:81.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's continue that quarrel from before. After $$カレン$$, I'll take you on.」

425:t_1:82.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll do it too. I want to master the $$ユニコーン$$ better too, you know.」
